capabilities: Browse vault folders and notes as a todo tree in the left sidebar
Toggle a completion checkbox on each note, persisted in frontmatter
Create, sort, auto-reveal, and expand/collapse notes and folders via a File explorer-style toolbar
Use context menu actions (rename, delete, copy path, bookmarks, open in new tab)
disambiguation: Not a task-list or checkbox parser inside notes; it adds per-note completion checkboxes to a file-tree sidebar view.
extras: README includes English and Chinese documentation, mobile usage instructions, and states the plugin works fully offline with no network reporting; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: The stock File explorer is unchanged. Use Todo Note when you want a completion-focused browse surface next to it.
problem: Obsidian's stock File explorer treats notes as files only and offers no way to mark a note itself as done while browsing.

relations.evidence: 体验类似 Joplin 的Todo Note

summary: Sidebar tree view that lists vault folders and notes like the File explorer, adding a completion checkbox to each note stored in frontmatter.
